title: Quarterly rollout contracts and OKR cadence for Private/VPC on‑prem activations
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary: Define a repeatable quarterly cadence that turns high-touch Private/VPC/on‑prem activations into contractable waves tied to OKRs and SLAs. The goal is to reduce bespoke onboarding lift by 40% while preserving enterprise SLAs (latency, uptime, auditability) and providing clear acceptance gates for Finance, Security and Customer Success.

Goals: 1) Produce a 'rollout contract' template (contractual commitments, activation windows, support entitlement, failure budget) for sales/CS to include in enterprise deals. 2) Map OKRs to measurable rollout signals (activation conversion, time-to-first-traffic, SLA attainment, ops MTTR). 3) Define a quarterly runway that coordinates Engineering, SRE, Security, and CS for three parallel customer cohorts (Pilot, Early, Standard).

Scope: Playbooks for activation lanes (Pilot, Early, Standard), acceptance criteria, canary plan, escalation matrix, cost/capacity hedging rules, billing contract clauses, audit/KMS attestations, and a template SLO/SLA addendum. Includes runbook snippets for egress/VPC network checks, health-check thresholds, and migration window templates.

Key trade-offs discussed: Lowering friction by standardizing activation windows vs. losing optional custom cutovers for largest customers. We propose a configurable contract addendum that allows +/- 14 day custom windows for top-tier accounts while defaulting others to the standardized cadence. Another trade-off is strict preflight gating (adds lead time) versus more permissive dark launches; adoption metrics will inform tightening gating after two quarters.

Links & artifacts: Confluence master playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private-rollout-playbook (draft); Activation spec PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-rollouts/pull/182; Dashboard: https://analytics.redwood.ai/dashboards/private-activation-runway; Example contract addendum (Google Drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/Private-Activation-Addendum (internal).

Acceptance criteria: 1) Contract template and addendum approved by Legal and RevOps. 2) Three cohort lanes documented with preflight checklist for network/KMS/audit. 3) Console feature flags that enable cohort gating and per-tenant activation windows. 4) Pilot with 2 customers signed and run through the playbook end-to-end. 5) Dashboard showing cohort conversion and SLA attainment for the quarter.

Next steps (owner assignments): PM (Liam) to finalize contract template with Legal by 2026-03-18; SRE (assigned ENG contact) to deliver preflight automation scripts by 2026-03-31; Security lead to complete KMS attestation checklist by 2026-03-22; CS to identify pilot customers and sign NDAs by 2026-03-25.

Signals for success: 50% reduction in bespoke onboarding tasks logged in JIRA; Pilot customers achieve production traffic within 10 business days of acceptance; No more than one SLA breach per quarter across pilot customers; documented NPS for activation experience >= +50.

Open questions: 1) Should billing commit be monthly or quarterly for reserved capacity during activation windows? 2) How to surface per-tenant audit logs to customer SIEMs securely without exposing cross-tenant metadata?
